// diagnostic

E2808

HTTP route method `{method}` is refused: {reason}.

What

HTTP route method `{method}` is refused: {reason}.

Why

A custom route method is an RFC 9110 token, kept in the exact case it is sent. A standard method spelled exactly registers with its own verb, so `custom` refuses it; one check runs on a static method while building and on a run-time method when its mux registers it.

Fix

Register a standard method with its own verb (`mux.get`), and give `custom` any other token of letters, digits and !#$%&'*+-.^_`|~.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2808: tests/ui/http_route_custom_method.stderr.

Error [jet.AmbiguousRoute]: Two routes both match `PURGE /cache`.
  --> http_route_custom_method.jet:27:9
    |
 27 |     mux.custom("PURGE", "/cache", handle)
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: A duplicate route makes dispatch ambiguous; mounted and value routes share one ordered list
 Fix: Remove one registration or use a distinct method and path
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2804

Error [jet.AmbiguousRoute]: Two routes both match `PURGE /marked`.
  --> http_route_custom_method.jet:12:5
    |
 12 |     #Server.Custom("PURGE", "/marked")
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A duplicate route makes dispatch ambiguous; mounted and value routes share one ordered list

Error [jet.RouteMethodTokenRefused]: HTTPRouter custom route method must be a static String
  --> http_route_custom_method.jet:32:19
    |
 32 |     router.custom(names[0], "/cache", handle)
    |                   ^^^^^
 Why: Router and `#Server.Custom` routes are fully checked while building; only a mux takes a run-time method, checked when it registers
 Fix: Use a literal or compile-time String constant, or register the route on a mux
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2808
